name: Vendetta
body:
Those who are foolish enough to cross you suffer the full extent of your fury.

Prerequisite(s): Challenge class feature; Base Attack Bonus +6

Benefit: As a move action, you may shift the target of your challenge to another enemy who has dealt damage to you in the current combat. If the challenge has expired due to the death or defeat of its previous target then this ability does not apply.
